thai_do.9: Attitude number 9: tolerant, generous — sometimes distant.
thai_do.11: Attitude number 11: sensitive, inspiring — sometimes tense.

truong_thanh.2: Maturity number 2: later in life you come to value relationships, cooperation and harmony.
truong_thanh.3: Maturity number 3: later in life you become more open, creative and expressive.
truong_thanh.4: Maturity number 4: later in life you lean towards stability and building solid foundations.
truong_thanh.5: Maturity number 5: later in life you need freedom, new experiences and change.
truong_thanh.6: Maturity number 6: later in life you lean towards family, responsibility and caring for others.
truong_thanh.7: Maturity number 7: later in life you turn inward, seeking depth and understanding.
truong_thanh.8: Maturity number 8: later in life you lean towards achievement, standing and finances.
truong_thanh.9: Maturity number 9: later in life you lean towards contribution, giving and meaning.
truong_thanh.11: Maturity number 11: later in life you lean towards inspiring others and the inner life.
truong_thanh.22: Maturity number 22: later in life you lean towards building something big and lasting for many people.
truong_thanh.33: Maturity number 33: later in life you lean towards supporting, healing and serving others.

ngay_ca_nhan_tu_soi.1: Is there something you have been putting off today where the first step alone would be enough?
ngay_ca_nhan_tu_soi.2: Who could you listen to a little more closely today instead of rushing to answer?
ngay_ca_nhan_tu_soi.3: Is there something you want to say or share that you have been holding back for a while?
ngay_ca_nhan_tu_soi.4: Which small task, if finished today, would clear your head for the whole week?
ngay_ca_nhan_tu_soi.5: Which small habit could you try doing differently today?
ngay_ca_nhan_tu_soi.6: Which loved one would be glad to hear from you today?
ngay_ca_nhan_tu_soi.7: What half-finished thought could use a short moment of quiet?
ngay_ca_nhan_tu_soi.8: Which practical decision do you already have enough information to settle?
ngay_ca_nhan_tu_soi.9: What should you close or let go of a little to make room for something new?

13.y_nghia: In the numerology tradition, 13 is linked to a lesson about discipline and persistence: a pull towards shortcuts, and discouragement when things take a long time.
13.goi_y: Pick one long-term task and work on it a little every day; this is a lesson about habits, not something imposed on you.

14.y_nghia: 14 is linked to a lesson about moderation and freedom with responsibility: a tendency to overindulge and lose a sense of measure.
14.goi_y: Set clear limits on the things you tend to overdo (spending, eating, screen time).

16.y_nghia: 16 is linked to a lesson about the ego: when you are too sure you are right, you may have to rebuild what you built — and the rebuilt version is usually sturdier.
16.goi_y: Actively ask a trusted person for honest feedback every quarter.

19.y_nghia: 19 is linked to a lesson about independence and asking for help: a tendency to carry everything alone and find it hard to accept support.
19.goi_y: Practise asking for help with one small thing each week.
